title: Write the ownership map for all fifteen areas
action: Per D3 and D4's ownership map: on every area's `overview.md` add `owns.code`, `owns.skills`, `owns.tests` under `bee:` — the code paths (crate modules under packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/), skill paths (skills/<name>/ trees), and test files the area governs. Derive each list from the area's existing prose 'Pointers (implementation)' sections and from rg over the crate for the area's verbs; prefer explicit module paths or trailing-`*` patterns, never mid-path globs. Three areas have no overview.md (feedback-digest, performance-log, verify-pipeline carry only the generated, reserved index.md): author a bee.area `overview.md` for each following the frontmatter of an existing overview (workflow-state/overview.md is the model), with title, description, bee.id, lifecycle, areas, authoritative_for, and the owns.* keys; then regenerate the indexes with `bee knowledge index` so the generated index.md files list the new concepts. Exit: `bee knowledge check` reports zero owns_missing and zero dangling_owns over docs/knowledge/ — run it through the freshly built binary from koh-2 (`cargo run --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- knowledge check`).
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo run --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- knowledge check && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo run --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- knowledge index --check

truths: Every one of the fifteen area directories has an overview.md carrying owns.code, owns.skills, owns.tests
bee knowledge check reports zero owns_missing and zero dangling_owns on the live bundle
